title: The Phone Careem's Founders Took Turns Sleeping Beside
conflicts: Start-up money: Sheikha says they began with $100,000 and were 'down $60,000 to $70,000' after office, card deposit and licences; ambiguous whether spent or left, so his words are quoted. Founding month: July 2012 per Careem's 2013 press release, other sources say only 2012. Acquisition: $3 billion (McKinsey, Entrepreneur ME) vs $3.1 billion (Monocle); story says about $3.1 billion, completed 2020. The 1,000+ cars in 2013 is Careem's own press-release claim and is attributed. A reported Ramadan launch could not be confirmed and is omitted.
notes: Distinct from the Swvl and Souq editions (founding and first year only). McKinsey interview cited from mckinsey.com.br because mckinsey.com returns 403. The Talks at Google transcript on rosetta.to is machine-generated, so it supports facts only and supplies no quotation.
